notes: I turned the tall ad into a 728×90 strip that reads left to right, all on the full-canvas fog background. From the left: the logo is centred top to bottom (72×32, same proportions as the original). Next comes the headline on two lines at 14 px, with the subhead on two lines at 8 px under it. In the middle, the three plan cards keep their original order and sit side by side, each 72×74 with a 6 px gap. Each card still stacks the plan name, a large price at 24 px and the 'per' line. On the right, the orange 'Start Free Week' button is 140×30 with its label on one line at 12 px. The legal text goes under the button on three or four lines at 7 px. 7 px is the smallest text here and is about as small as legal copy can go and still be read. Everything stays at least 8 px from every edge, and the only overlaps are text sitting on its own card or button.
